A1.neg: The stones must stay crosswise rectangular baguettes in ONE single row, never round brilliants, never two rows, never set lengthways; every stone stays colourless and icy clear, never tinted, never milky; no centre stone, no charm, no station.
A1.scale: Each baguette is about 6mm by 3mm, the size of a grain of rice; the bracelet is about 17cm long and only 6mm wide, a bright fine band.
